purpose: Prepare audited training-only spatial-memory supervision for return navigation
motivation: Expanded model return failures comprise four trips never reaching docking range and three arriving with wrong heading; none were ready-pose stop failures
targetFormat: PVPOSE01; original N, fitting count and T; each pre-action row is FP32 [local_dx/8,local_dy/8,sin(relative_yaw),cos(relative_yaw),valid_mask]
frame: Relative to the episode's initial base pose, rotated into initial body axes; no absolute world coordinates or map supplied to the actor
alignment: Label current RGB and own-feedback input using initial pose for action0 and the preceding recorded post-action pose thereafter
verification: Match dataset pixels and feedback to recorded actor files, reconstruct pose independently from full per-tick physical trace, inverse-transform every target and check valid masks and padding
targetUse: Potential auxiliary loss on recurrent memory only; never actor inputs, goals, controller, scans or fallback
trainingSupport: Native training-only four-value memory head implemented and contract-tested; full-data task comparison pending
